units.source_text: 孽由自作而无人得知的愁恨，在源氏公子是永无停息的。

en.t: For Prince Genji, the sorrow and resentment born of his own actions, yet known to no one, never came to an end.

units.source_text: 然而如今时移世变，连寻常一举一动，也无非增人忧恼。

en.t: But now times had changed, and even the most ordinary gesture or action only deepened people's distress.

units.source_text: 这便使得源氏公子心灰意懒，顿萌厌世之念。

en.t: This left Prince Genji disheartened and weary, and a sudden longing to withdraw from the world arose in him.

units.source_text: 无奈恋恋不舍之事颇多。

en.t: Yet there were still many things he loved too deeply to leave behind.
